title: Recipe marketplace và governance
scope_items: Target 1 (Install preserves canonical graph): When a recipe is installed, it instantiates an editable canonical M20 workflow object with the recipe's triggers, conditions, and actions. Substituted parameters replace declared placeholders; the workflow is not a locked black box and is fully editable via M20 Workflow Builder.

Target 2 (Missing capability explained): When a recipe requires capabilities not available in the workspace, installation is blocked with a structured user-facing diagnostic explaining the exact connector, missing action, root cause, and direct resolution URL.

Target 3 (Tenant/system template isolation): Published system recipes (workspace_id == null) are globally visible but read-only. Private tenant recipes are strictly isolated via RLS and tenant validation, preventing cross-tenant discovery or tampering.
Review & Rating System: Enables 1-5 star reviews, textual feedback, and incremental average rating aggregation per recipe template.

Governance Submission & 48h Takedown (Pack 06 S22): Implements creator recipe submission for review (3-day SLA), admin review/approval, and 48-hour DMCA / policy takedown lifecycle while preserving installed instances.
Revenue Share (RULE-M21-006): Exact 70/30 creator/platform split and 7-day refund window using NUMERIC(18,6) decimal precision (no floating-point arithmetic).
